description: Land Settlement Dept. - Giritala Puranagama, Higurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120118
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their locations, extents, ownership details (primarily "The State"), and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land administration matters, including title settlements, parcel identifications, and land ownership declarations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
